CANONICAL_NAME.value: lru-cache -- a C++ LRU cache (Peter Goldsborough)

VERSION.value: github.com/goldsborough/lru-cache master as of 2026-09-12 (commit in hashes)

value.lineage: LRU (least-recently-used) eviction: when a bounded cache is full, discard the entry unused for longest; a hash-map + intrusive list, the standard caching mechanism across CPUs, OSes and databases

value.built_to: keep the most useful bounded subset of data in fast memory by evicting the least-recently-used entry when capacity is exceeded
value.pressure: memory/cache far smaller than the data; every miss costs a slow fetch, so the eviction choice determines performance
value.success_means: a high hit rate on workloads with temporal locality, within a fixed capacity

value.pressure: bounded memory, a working set larger than capacity, temporal-locality (or its absence)
value.failure_condition: cache thrashing: when the working set exceeds capacity and locality is poor, the hit rate collapses toward zero and the cache is pure overhead

ANCESTRY.value: LRU (least-recently-used) eviction: when a bounded cache is full, discard the entry unused for longest; a hash-map + intrusive list, the standard caching mechanism across CPUs, OSes and databases
